name: Carolina Foods
old_description: Since 1934, Carolina Foods has been an innovator in the category of sweet baked goods.
about:
Carolina Foods was founded in 1934 in Charlotte, North Carolina, as an innovator in sweet baked goods. The company remains headquartered in Charlotte and operates a state-of-the-art baking facility in nearby Pineville. No founders are named in public records, and ownership structure is not disclosed.

The company produces a range of sweet baked goods including Gem Donuts, Donut Sticks, Honey Buns, Fritters, Cinnamon Rolls, and Mini Pies under its Duchess brand, while also serving as a private-label and co-manufacturing partner. Its Pineville facility employs automated baking and packaging lines, notably a Schubert packaging system, and the company emphasizes 100% scratch-made formulations with extended shelf-life technology. Carolina Foods supplies over 21,000 convenience stores, 8,600 value retailers, 4,500 conventional grocers, 3,400 mass-market retailers, and 873 club stores.

Customers span retail chains, private-label brands, co-manufacturing clients, and food-service operators such as quick-serve restaurants and hospitality venues. The company cites leading retailers as partners but does not name specific brands.

Carolina Foods differentiates itself through its heritage as the first to develop extended shelf-life technology for sweet baked goods and the first to introduce the honey bun. It manages every production step in-house to ensure quality, safety, and faster innovation, an approach recognized by a Food Engineering 2025 Plant of the Year Award.
